title: THE BLOCK: Thailand's SEC is seeking public comment on draft rules for domestic crypto ETFs, with Bitcoin and Ethereum proposed as the first eligible assets. The funds would trade exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Tha
snippet: THE BLOCK: Thailand's SEC is seeking public comment on draft rules for domestic crypto ETFs, with Bitcoin and Ethereum proposed as the first eligible assets. The funds would trade exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand and maintain at least 80% average net exposure to a single crypto asset.

title: Blockchain Association backs Treasury’s proposed GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
snippet: It backs limiting client ID requirements to direct issuer-customer transactions in the primary market, while calling for clearer definitions.

title: Thailand moves closer to Bitcoin, Ether ETFs with draft rules
snippet: Thailand’s SEC opened consultations on local Bitcoin and Ether ETF rules and qualification standards for foreign digital asset custodians.

title: THE BLOCK: Bitcoin treasury firm Metaplanet's Tokyo-listed stock rose 8.2% to close Tuesday at 330 yen ($2.07). The stock surged nearly 45% over the past five days, data shows.

title: Bernstein sees new USDC growth cycle, sets $140 Circle price target
snippet: USDC supply increased by roughly $2 billion in seven days, with Bernstein citing higher transaction activity and several factors that could support further growth.
